rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The President's reply to the State of the Nation debate, dated 16 February 2023 and delivered at the Cape Town City Hall, addresses 'Deputy President David Mabuza' in its salutation.

locator.section: Salutation at the head of the reply

rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Closing the reply, the President thanks Deputy President David Mabuza for five years of support and says that Deputy President Mabuza has indicated his wish to step down from his position, a request that is being attended to.

locator.section: Concluding paragraphs, 'As I conclude, I wish to extend my appreciation to Deputy President David Mabuza'
